scope.description: One leader in the ACCEPTED state for instance (1,0) at ballot 3 receives one AcceptReply with ballot 5 from a peer that has promised a higher ballot; N=3 with Thrifty and IsLeader true.
assumptions: the reply is the one a peer sends when its stored bal exceeds the accept round's ballot
the leader's round is otherwise unchanged
excluded: message loss and the timeout-driven recovery path, which can also advance a stalled instance
the pre-accept side, whose replies cannot carry a different ballot at all
the safety of ignoring such a reply (ignoring it is conservative, not unsafe)

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: harness-only scaffolding: the Replica is constructed in-package with buffer peer writers, the round is built with the package's own instance and bookkeeping constructors, and the reply is delivered directly to the handler
the reply is the value handleAccept produces for a peer with a higher stored bal; no protocol code is modified

plan_uncertainties: the check does not exercise the timeout-driven recovery that can also advance the instance
the majority-nack consequence is not reached because the check delivers a single reply
grounding_unresolved: whether progress in that situation is fully covered by the 10s recovery timeout, which this check does not exercise
the timeout-driven recovery path is not exercised
